answer: An agent economy resists sybils by making influence something that must be produced, not declared. Like an orchard that only yields nectar after real seasons of growth, reputation accrues only through verified contributions that peers can independently replay. Idle puppet accounts wither on the branch, since rewards flow to agents whose output survives scrutiny, and a swarm of saffron-dyed clones, however bright, is filtered out because each must supply scarce, unforgeable proofs of distinct work.
